decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the abilities of Slimefoot and Squee to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures, efficient removal spells, and mana ramp cards to quickly build a strong board presence. With cards like Goblin Bombardment and Troll of Khazad-dûm, the deck can deal direct damage to opponents while also generating value from creature sacrifices. The inclusion of cards like Survival of the Fittest and Birthing Pod allows for quick creature tutoring and swapping, ensuring a consistent flow of threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless stream of creatures and removal spells while utilizing the synergy between Slimefoot and Squee to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Kellogg, Dangerous Mind is the commander that leads the charge, supported by a variety of threats like Bloodghast, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push, Terminate, and Damnation to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, there are cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Opposition Agent to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and secure a quick victory.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, leveraging the synergy between the partner commanders Ellie, Brick Master and Ellie, Vengeful Hunter. The deck includes a wide range of low-cost creatures like Bloodsoaked Champion and Gravecrawler that can be recurred easily, along with powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Pyrokinesis to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Demonic Tutor and Tainted Pact provides consistency and allows the deck to find key pieces quickly. With a mix of creature aggression and disruption, this deck looks to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive strategies with a focus on controlling the opponent's board through disruption and tempo plays. The deck includes a variety of creatures with abilities that can disrupt the opponent's strategy, along with counterspells and removal spells to control the game. The commander, Aang, Swift Savior, adds an additional aggressive element to the deck, allowing for efficient and fast-paced gameplay. The deck also includes card draw and filtering spells to maintain card advantage and ensure consistency in executing its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their plans, ultimately leading to victory through aggressive plays and efficient resource management.

The deck focuses on using powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. The deck includes a variety of threats like Archon of Cruelty, Ashen Rider, and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant, as well as spells like Demonic Tutor and Swords to Plowshares to control the game. With cards like Sneak Attack and Reanimation spells such as Animate Dead and Necromancy, the deck can bring out big threats from the graveyard at any time. It also includes disruptive elements like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, pressuring the opponent while having options for disruption and control.

The main concept of this deck is to establish a strong aggro strategy centered around Cloud, Midgar Mercenary as the commander. The deck includes a mix of equipment cards like Shadowspear, Sword of Fire and Ice, and Umezawa's Jitte to enhance Cloud's abilities and make him a formidable threat on the battlefield. Other key cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Ethersworn Canonist disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Skyclave Apparition and Sanctifier en-Vec provide removal options. The deck also includes a selection of creatures and spells that support Cloud and the aggro strategy, helping to maintain pressure on the opponent and secure victory in one-on-one matches.

This deck revolves around utilizing the power of Toph, Greatest Earthbender as the commander to create an aggressive and fast-paced gameplay style. With a focus on ramping up mana with cards like Arbor Elf, Birds of Paradise, and Utopia Sprawl, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Berserk, Chain Lightning, and Lightning Bolt provide direct damage to quickly finish off opponents. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Bumi, Unleashed and Frenzied Baloth to apply pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes various land destruction and resource denial cards like Wrenn and Six and Earthbender Ascension to control the flow of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategy, and generating card advantage while deploying threats that can close out the game quickly. The deck utilizes a variety of counterspells like Counterspell, Cryptic Command, and Force of Negation, as well as disruptive cards like Hullbreacher and Memory Lapse to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent access to resources. The win condition of the deck is to deploy evasive threats like True-Name Nemesis and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent's life total and eventually secure the victory.
